transcript.statement: Safety and reliability are paramount for the RollCall system as it deals with sensitive student attendance data. Requirements SAF-01 and SAF-02 ensure secure authentication and real-time data synchronization, preventing unauthorized access and discrepancies. SAF-03 provides alerts for reporting inaccuracies, while SAF-04 supports long-term data analysis essential for decision-making. requirements.text: The system shall ensure secure authentication of users and encrypt all attendance data to protect it from unauthorized access.
The system shall implement a phased secure data synchronization approach to ensure real-time processing without compromising safety.
The system shall provide real-time alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy and accountability.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years to comply with educational regulations and support long-term analysis.
The system shall log all attendance modifications with timestamps and user identification to ensure accountability.
The system shall allow students to view their attendance records securely after successful authentication.
The system shall support at least 500 concurrent users without performance degradation.
The system shall implement load balancing to optimize resource utilization across multiple classes and semesters.
The system shall provide a user interface that responds to user interactions within 1 second.
The system shall notify students of their attendance status via email or app notification within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall minimize energy consumption during data processing operations by implementing efficient algorithms.
The system shall ensure data retention policies that align with sustainable resource management practices.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access to authorized personnel only.
